e.title: 保险客户端经营归因 Agent
e.summary: 保险销售客户端归因 Agent（GOAI 竞赛交付，38★，2026-09）：异动下钻/证据分级/因果归因/反事实验证
e.body: insurance-client-attribution（legeZZZ，38★，Python，2026-09-03 更新）是 GOAI（AI+金融）竞赛交付：保险销售客户端经营归因 Agent——经营指标异常时自动化回答「变了多少是真的、哪个因子造成、下一步做什么实验」；含组件归因（Growth UI Spec 三类 Diff → FactorMiner → 聚合 Beta-Binomial 门禁 → 高维重叠 CATE/HTE → 因子化实验）与实验基线归因（A/B 持续对照 → rate-aware 候选生成 → 内外因子关联 → 反事实验证），证据分级状态机与 Claim Ledger 约束。对 RIAA：保险增长分析的因果归因 Agent——把 [[insurance-causal]]（burning-cost 定价因果）方法延伸到客户经营归因；反事实与门禁逻辑衔接 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（因果政策评估）；中文保险平台经营场景。

e.title_hk: 保險客戶端經營歸因 Agent
e.summary_en: Insurance sales client-attribution agent (GOAI competition deliverable, 38★, 2026-09): anomaly drill-down / evidence grading / causal attribution / counterfactual validation
e.summary_hk: 保險銷售客戶端歸因 Agent（GOAI 競賽交付，38★，2026-09）：異動下鑽/證據分級/因果歸因/反事實驗證
e.body_en: insurance-client-attribution (legeZZZ, 38★, Python, updated 2026-09-03) is a GOAI (AI+finance) competition deliverable: an insurance sales client-operations attribution agent that automatically answers "how much of the change is real, which factor caused it, what experiment to run next" when business metrics move — with component attribution (Growth UI Spec three Diff classes → FactorMiner → aggregated Beta-Binomial gate → high-dimensional overlapping CATE/HTE → factorial experiments) and experiment-baseline attribution (continuous A/B baselines → rate-aware candidate generation → internal/external factor linkage → counterfactual validation), constrained by an evidence-grading state machine and a Claim Ledger. For RIAA: a causal-attribution agent for insurance growth analytics — extending the [[insurance-causal]] (burning-cost pricing causality) methodology to client-operations attribution; the counterfactual/gating logic connects to [[insurance-causal-policy]] (causal policy evaluation); Chinese insurance-platform business scenarios.
e.body_hk: insurance-client-attribution（legeZZZ，38★，Python，2026-09-03 更新）是 GOAI（AI+金融）競賽交付：保險銷售客戶端經營歸因 Agent——經營指標異常時自動化回答「變了多少是真的、哪個因子造成、下一步做什麼實驗」；含組件歸因（Growth UI Spec 三類 Diff → FactorMiner → 聚合 Beta-Binomial 門禁 → 高維重疊 CATE/HTE → 因子化實驗）與實驗基線歸因（A/B 持續對照 → rate-aware 候選生成 → 內外因子關聯 → 反事實驗證），證據分級狀態機與 Claim Ledger 約束。對 RIAA：保險增長分析的因果歸因 Agent——把 [[insurance-causal]]（burning-cost 定價因果）方法延伸到客戶經營歸因；反事實與門禁邏輯銜接 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（因果政策評估）；中文保險平台經營場景。
